IN CASE YOU MISSED IT: Natalana nga power interruption bwas nga adlaw, September 13, 2026 (Sunday).
Yari ang detalye sang power advisory.

SCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION: SEPTEMBER 13, 2026
Ginapahibalo sang Negros Power ang mga konsumidores nga may ara sang natalana nga power interruption sa September 13, 2026 (Sunday).
Ini kabahin sang 5-year rehabilitation kag modernization plan sang Negros Power agud malikawan ang mga wala ginalauman kag mas lapnagon nga power interruptions kag mangin reliable ang distribution system sang aton elektrisidad.
Yari ang mga detalye sang scheduled power interruption:
Date: September 13, 2026 (Sunday)
Reason: 
● Extension of 0.5 km 3PH Tree Wire from Purok Lampirong to Bredco; and
● Reconductoring of 07 km 3Ph 1/0 ACSR to 336.4 Tree Wire along Palanca Rd. To Cor. Burgos-Panlanca St.
Time & Affected Areas:
6:00AM to 6:00PM
Portion of RF1 - Purok Lampirong, Purok Narra Baybay Brgy 8, Portion of Reclamation Area.
Portion of RF4 - Portion of Reclamation Area, Portion of Brgy 8, Bacolod City.
Madamo gid nga salamat sa inyo nga pag hangop.
#NegrosPowerRehab
#PadayonAngRehabilitasyon
#ForBetterElectricService
